title: "Schedule"
---

| Week | Lecture | Studio output | Assessment milestone |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | Seeing Data: Visualisation, Intelligence, and Interpretation | Critique 1 | Diagnostic quiz |
| 2 | Choosing Visual Forms: Encoding, Tidy Data, and the Visual Vocabulary | Critique 2 + visual vocabulary sort | Weekly quiz |
| 3 | Dashboards, Personas, and User Stories: Tableau Public | Tableau dashboard planning + build | Tableau Dashboard Checkpoint |
| 4 | Interactive Data Apps with Streamlit | Local Streamlit MVP | Weekly quiz |
| 5 | From Prototype to Public Data Product | Deployed app prototype + disclosure draft | Public Data Product Checkpoint |
| 6 | Web Visualisation Studio: Maps, Flows, Animation, 3D, and JavaScript Literacy | Specialised Visualisation Decision | Weekly quiz |
| 7 | Responsible Interpretation and Visualisation Quality Review | Quality Review + revision log | Studio Critique 3 + Quality Review |
| 8 | Present and Defend: Visual Intelligence in Practice | Presentation + oral defence | Final app + oral defence |

## Weekly rhythm

Each session is three hours:

| Segment | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Hour 1 | Concept and examples |
| Hour 2 | Build or technical practice |
| Hour 3 | Critique, review, repair, or studio work |
